items.title: I got two email invitations from friends. Is this a phishing scam — or am I suddenly popular?
items.description: “I was surprised — and flattered — to find myself on the guest list.”

items.title: ‘I don’t wish to be cold-hearted’: My elderly relative can no longer care for himself. Am I wrong to leave his care to the state?
items.description: “He has never been particularly generous or nurturing.”

items.title: Sandisk’s stock falls as the company’s forecast doesn’t live up to high expectations
items.description: The midpoint of the company’s revenue forecast was below what analysts had been modeling.

items.title: Block slashed 40% of its workforce for AI — and its earnings suggest that’s paying off
items.description: “We can ship higher-quality products much, much more quickly,” an executive said in the wake of the company’s better-than-expected earnings report

items.title: Figma’s stock falls as the company’s AI push requires steep investments
items.description: While Figma’s consumption-based AI monetization strategy is showing promise, the company’s margins are taking a hit.

items.title: Why AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares are down after SpaceX’s earnings

items.title: SpaceX’s stock falls as Wall Street gets spooked by the extent of AI spending

items.title: Nvidia’s stock is basking in the glow of a high-profile endorsement

items.title: Missouri voters just rejected a bid to ditch income tax, while other tax votes loom in Florida and California this fall

items.title: Alphabet’s stock drops as Google loses another key AI executive
items.description: Jeff Dean, Google’s chief scientist and one of its first employees, is leaving to launch his own company.
